lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背鳍切出一道细线。
lines.en: I swim at the surface, my dorsal fin cutting a thin line.

lines.zh: 我们四只并排，像被同一股流推着。
lines.en: Four of us side by side, pushed by one current.

lines.zh: 我轻轻一弹，窜出去一丈。
lines.en: One light flick and I shoot a body-length ahead.

lines.zh: 海水是空的，我就成了里面一点银。
lines.en: The sea is empty; I am one silver dot inside it.

lines.zh: 我上浮到光里，又沉回蓝里。
lines.en: I rise into the light and sink back into the blue.

lines.zh: 后面的同伴学我拐弯，慢半拍。
lines.en: The one behind copies my turn, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我顺着洋流走，鳍几乎不用动。
lines.en: I ride the current with my fins nearly still.

lines.zh: 一小群沙丁鱼过去，我让开了。
lines.en: A small school of sardines passes; I give way.

lines.zh: 我跃出水面半尺，又拍回去。
lines.en: I leap half a foot out and slap back down.

lines.zh: 浪把我抬高，我不挣扎。
lines.en: The swell lifts me and I do not struggle.

lines.zh: 我认路靠的是水的味道。
lines.en: I find my way by the taste of the water.

lines.zh: 我们三只绕着一个漩涡转。
lines.en: The three of us circle one slow eddy.

lines.zh: 我游得很轻，像没有骨头。
lines.en: I swim so lightly it feels like I have no bones.

lines.zh: 洋面那么宽，我往哪边都不算错。
lines.en: The ocean is so wide that no direction is wrong.

lines.zh: 我贴着浅滩的沙纹游过去
lines.en: I swim along the ripples of the shallows

lines.zh: 一群鱼散了，我又聚回去
lines.en: The school scatters and I gather back in

lines.zh: 我停在半水里，随水一起晃。
lines.en: I hang mid-water, swaying along with it.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我背上，凉凉的。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my back, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，等水流带吃的进来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the current bring food.

lines.zh: 四只鱼，谁也没说话，就这样待着。
lines.en: Four fish, none speaking, just staying here.

lines.zh: 我身上那点银，在水里不算亮。
lines.en: My silver is not bright underwater.

lines.zh: 有东西在我底下游过，我没理。
lines.en: Something passes beneath me; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的鲸叫，压得很低。
lines.en: I hear a distant whale call, very low.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看它浮上去破掉。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it rise and break.

lines.zh: 这片海把我养得很轻。
lines.en: This sea has raised me to be light.

lines.zh: 我的骨头最后会变成一撮粉。
lines.en: My bones will end up a pinch of powder.

lines.zh: 水面在动，我在下面不动。
lines.en: The surface moves; I stay still beneath it.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己从哪个浪里来。
lines.en: I cannot recall which wave I came from.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水流洗鳃。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the current rinse my gills.

lines.zh: 空着就空着，我不急着找什么。
lines.en: Empty is empty; I am in no hurry to find anything.

lines.zh: 你站在海边，我浮上来看了你一眼。
lines.en: You stand by the sea; I surface and glance at you.

lines.zh: 你的影子投到水里，像一块暗礁。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water like a dark reef.

lines.zh: 你的网在水里张开了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your net opens underwater; I see it.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗蛋，画着我们。
lines.en: That egg in your hand is painted with us.

lines.zh: 我绕着你腿边游，水里有你的味道。
lines.en: I swim around your legs; the water tastes of you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们四只一起看你。
lines.en: You crouch, and the four of us look back.

lines.zh: 你眼里有光，我这里只有水。
lines.en: There is light in your eyes; here I have only water.

lines.zh: 你想数清我们，我们一直动。
lines.en: You try to count us; we never stop moving.

lines.zh: 你比我大太多了，可我不怕。
lines.en: You are so much larger, yet I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，谁也不动。
lines.en: You watch me, I watch you; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏了半尺，鳃还在动。
lines.en: I am knocked half a foot off course, gills still working.

lines.zh: 一片鳞翻起来，露出底下的白。
lines.en: A scale lifts and shows the white beneath.

lines.zh: 疼从侧面来，我分不清方向。
lines.en: The pain comes from the side and I lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 我沉了一下，尾巴先醒过来。
lines.en: I sink a little; my tail wakes first.

lines.zh: 我的血在水里变成很淡的一缕。
lines.en: My blood becomes a very faint thread in the water.

lines.zh: 我这点肉，不够你吃一口。
lines.en: This little flesh of mine is not one mouthful for you.

lines.zh: 骨头要是碎了，也只能当粉用。
lines.en: If my bones break, powder is all they are good for.

lines.zh: 我挣扎着往深处钻。
lines.en: I struggle downward into the dark.

lines.zh: 四只同伴走了三只。
lines.en: Three of my four schoolmates are gone.

lines.zh: 我还活着，只是游不快了。
lines.en: I am alive, only slower now.

lines.zh: 那点碎肉落下来，我先退后一步。
lines.en: The scrap of flesh falls; I back off first.

lines.zh: 气味散开，我们四只都转过来。
lines.en: The smell spreads and all four of us turn.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又合上，还是算了。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and decide against it.

lines.zh: 你撒的饵在水里打转，好看。
lines.en: Your bait spins in the water; it looks lovely.

lines.zh: 我靠着水面，等你再扔一颗。
lines.en: I stay near the surface, waiting for another piece.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，味道像我自己。
lines.en: I take a bite and it tastes like my own kind.

lines.zh: 想用吃的换我进桶，你试试吧。
lines.en: Try trading food for my place in a bucket.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转了圈，没上钩。
lines.en: I circle the bait once and do not take it.

lines.zh: 饿了是真的，警惕也是真的。
lines.en: The hunger is real; so is the caution.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，饵沉下去了，我跟着。
lines.en: Your hand slips; the bait sinks and I follow it.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我像一片叶子飘开了。
lines.en: You touch me and I drift off like a leaf.

lines.zh: 我太轻，撞一下就被推很远。
lines.en: I am so light one bump carries me far.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶到水，我绕开了。
lines.en: Your knee pushes the water; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我们四只挤在一起，谁都撞谁。
lines.en: The four of us crowd and bump each other.

lines.zh: 网绳擦过我的鳍，凉得刺人。
lines.en: The net cord grazes my fin, cold and sharp.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，水花溅到你脸上。
lines.en: I flick and water splashes your face.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，整片浅水都乱了。
lines.en: You step into the water and the shallows churn.

lines.zh: 撞完我掉头，游出你的影子。
lines.en: After the bump I turn and leave your shadow.

lines.zh: 别推我，我本来就站不稳。
lines.en: Do not push me; I am unsteady as it is.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推到了浪外面。
lines.en: That shove carried me past the break.

lines.zh: 两条鱼并着肩，鳞片挨着鳞片。
lines.en: Two fish shoulder to shoulder, scale against scale.

lines.zh: 三只同伴都退开，只留我们两个。
lines.en: The three others draw back and leave us two.

lines.zh: 我贴着它的侧腹，一起上浮。
lines.en: I press to its flank and we rise together.

lines.zh: 海水暖起来，我们就知道时候到了。
lines.en: The water warms and we know the time has come.

lines.zh: 卵撒进洋流，谁也带不走。
lines.en: The eggs scatter into the current; no one can hold them.

lines.zh: 它转一圈，我跟着转一圈。
lines.en: It turns once; I turn once after it.

lines.zh: 我们没有巢，海就是巢。
lines.en: We build no nest; the sea is the nest.

lines.zh: 这条鱼游得比我稳，我选它。
lines.en: This one swims steadier than I do; I choose it.

lines.zh: 过了这阵，我们又各游各的。
lines.en: When this passes we will each swim our own way.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰了碰它，它没有躲。
lines.en: I touch it with a fin and it does not pull away.

lines.zh: 水里漂来一片木屑，我推了推。
lines.en: A wood chip floats by; I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只有一张会张合的嘴。
lines.en: I have no hands, only a mouth that opens and shuts.

lines.zh: 东西沉下去，我跟着看了一会儿。
lines.en: The thing sinks; I follow it with my eyes a while.

lines.zh: 那颗卵石太重，我推不动。
lines.en: That pebble is too heavy; I cannot move it.

lines.zh: 你掉的饵，算水里的了。
lines.en: The bait you dropped now belongs to the water.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶了一下，它就歪了。
lines.en: I butt it once with my mouth and it tips over.

lines.zh: 捡东西是岸上的事。
lines.en: Picking things up is a business for the shore.

lines.zh: 我绕着那东西游三圈，还是走了。
lines.en: I circle the thing three times and still leave.

lines.zh: 它卡在石头缝里，我帮不上。
lines.en: It is wedged in the rocks; I cannot help.

lines.zh: 我的鳍只够划水，不够拿。
lines.en: My fins are good for swimming, not for holding.

lines.zh: 有个影子从深水升上来，我盯住了。
lines.en: A shadow rises from the deep; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 那种大利齿鱼，我们从不靠近。
lines.en: That big toothed fish, we never go near it.

lines.zh: 水面晃了一下，我先沉下去。
lines.en: The surface shudders and I sink first.

lines.zh: 我听见网在水里的声音。
lines.en: I hear the sound a net makes underwater.

lines.zh: 四只里我最小，所以我先跑。
lines.en: I am smallest of the four, so I flee first.

lines.zh: 有东西一直跟着我们。
lines.en: Something has been following us for a while.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把白肚皮藏起来。
lines.en: I turn to hide my pale belly.

lines.zh: 那股味道不对，是血。
lines.en: That smell is wrong; it is blood.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个影子，等它先动。
lines.en: I keep my eye on that shadow until it stirs.

lines.zh: 我不打算打，只打算走。
lines.en: I do not plan to fight, only to leave.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶慢慢绕，等你伸手。
lines.en: I circle slowly above you, waiting for your hand.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，水就告诉我了。
lines.en: When you come near, the water tells me.

lines.zh: 我退到光的边缘，那边更暗。
lines.en: I retreat to the edge of the light, where it is darker.

lines.zh: 我们拉开距离，像撒开的网眼。
lines.en: We spread out like the mesh of a net.

lines.zh: 你的动作太慢，水比你先动。
lines.en: Your movement is slow; the water moves before you.

lines.zh: 我先看你踩水的脚，再看你。
lines.en: I check the feet that wade first, then you.

lines.zh: 再往下三尺，你就抓不到了。
lines.en: Three feet lower and you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，把鳍贴着身子。
lines.en: I circle you with my fins tight to my body.

lines.zh: 这一圈游完，我就走。
lines.en: When this circle closes, I leave.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要怕你。
lines.en: I have not decided whether to fear you.

lines.zh: 我甩头撞你手腕，只够一下。
lines.en: I snap my head at your wrist, just once.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口，往后拖。
lines.en: I bite your cuff and pull backward.

lines.zh: 我这条鱼没什么力气，但牙齿尖。
lines.en: I have little strength, but my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 你把手伸进水里，就别怪我。
lines.en: You put your hand in the water; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我一挣，鳞从你指缝里滑出去。
lines.en: I twist and my scales slide through your fingers.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一扫，水面全泼向你。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail throws the surface at you.

lines.zh: 我们四只一起撞你，你退了两步。
lines.en: All four of us ram you and you step back twice.

lines.zh: 我只想脱身，不想伤你。
lines.en: I only want to get free; I do not want to hurt you.

lines.zh: 你松开一点，我就不咬了。
lines.en: Loosen your grip and I stop biting.

lines.zh: 这一口很浅，是给你留面子。
lines.en: This bite is shallow, to spare your dignity.

lines.zh: 我在这片外海睁开眼，四周全是蓝。
lines.en: I open my eyes in open sea, blue on every side.

lines.zh: 四只小鱼挤在一道浪里。
lines.en: Four small fish crowd inside one wave.

lines.zh: 洋流把我推了一整夜。
lines.en: The current pushed me along all night.

lines.zh: 我比一片鳞大不了多少。
lines.en: I am barely bigger than one scale.

lines.zh: 那条画着我的蛋，此刻还空着。
lines.en: The egg painted with me is still empty now.

lines.zh: 我第一次上浮，光刺得我发晕。
lines.en: My first rise; the light makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 同伴用尾巴碰我，叫我跟紧。
lines.en: A schoolmate taps me with its tail: keep close.

lines.zh: 海面上有船，我不知道那是什么。
lines.en: There is a boat up there; I do not know what it is.

lines.zh: 骨头还没硬，我游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My bones are not set; I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 我落进海里，海没有多说什么。
lines.en: I fall into the sea and the sea says nothing.

lines.zh: 水面在烧，我躲到浪底下。
lines.en: The surface burns; I hide beneath the swell.

lines.zh: 我被浪抛到岸上，鳍拍着沙。
lines.en: A wave throws me ashore and my fins beat the sand.

lines.zh: 我离了水，才知道水有多重。
lines.en: Only out of water do I learn how heavy it is.

lines.zh: 爆炸在水下只剩一声低闷的响。
lines.en: Underwater, the blast is only one low thud.

lines.zh: 一根鱼叉扎进我旁边的水。
lines.en: A harpoon drives into the water beside me.

lines.zh: 魔法顺着水爬过来，我的鳞全竖了。
lines.en: Magic crawls through the water and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 我饿得只剩一层皮裹着骨头。
lines.en: Hunger leaves me skin wrapped over bone.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，我整条鱼抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 这里没有水压，也没了浮力。
lines.en: Here there is no water pressure, no buoyancy.
